the bound entry carries 2497 inputs (the union of the section's prior entries, compounded by the round-53 and round-54 re-keys); any byte change to one of them uncredits the section. Binding at the content-final commit is what keeps this from firing.

a reader with findings is NOT bound (binder prints SKIP reader-has-findings:n>0); --resolutions is the only way to allow a finding, and round 55 has no adjudication file, so every re-keyed reader must be clean.
